regions.description: RFC 0129. Opaque operator region codes the host can pin a run to (e.g. `"eu"`, `"us"`, `"eu-west-1"`). No closed registry — codes are the host's own vocabulary (a global region enum would be unfalsifiable). A host MUST advertise a code here only if it can process a run entirely within it; a run-create `residency.region` not in this list MUST be rejected `residency_unavailable`.
